metaTitle: Custom Full Color Highlighters | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color highlighters for your brand. Vibrant, printed highlighters perfect for trade shows and offices. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Full color printing on highlighters lets you reproduce logos, photos, or complex artwork with photographic clarity. Unlike standard one- or two-color imprints, full color digital decoration gives you the freedom to use gradients, detailed illustrations, and even small text that stays legible. This makes custom full color highlighters ideal for marketing directors who want to hand out a premium writing tool that doubles as a miniature billboard. The Dri Mark® Dry Erase No Roll Marker and Quad Highlighter are popular choices for this decoration method.
heroAltText: Assorted custom full color highlighters with vibrant printed logos and artwork on a white background
